beginner.summary: No CI/CD experience assumed. Participants write workflows that build, test, package and deploy applications on GitHub-hosted runners.
prerequisites: Uses Git and GitHub pull requests
Has built a small application locally
outcomes: Write workflows with triggers, jobs and steps
Build, test and publish artefacts and container images
Use secrets, environments and approvals safely
Deploy applications to a cloud with OIDC authentication

days.topic: CI/CD Concepts and GitHub Actions Setup
days.lab_task: Create a workflow that runs on every push and pull request, checks out the code, prints environment details and runs a simple test, and add its badge to the README.
days.deliverable: Workflow file, run logs and README badge
checks: Check appears on the pull request
Workflow fails with the error visible in logs
objectives: Explain the parts of a workflow

subtopics: Setting up language runtimes with setup actions
Running on Linux, Windows and macOS
days.lab_task: Write a CI workflow for a Python or Node.js project that installs dependencies, lints, runs tests, uploads the test report and writes a job summary.
days.deliverable: Workflow file and a run with the uploaded report and summary
objectives: Build and test code in workflows

subtopics: Concurrency groups to cancel old runs
days.lab_task: Configure workflows so docs changes skip CI, a nightly scheduled job runs dependency checks, a manual workflow takes an environment input, and new pushes cancel older runs on the same branch.
days.deliverable: Workflow files and runs showing each behaviour
checks: Run the manual workflow with an input
Input value appears in the logs
objectives: Save runner time with filters and concurrency

days.lab_task: Split CI into lint, test and build jobs with dependencies, test on three runtime versions and two operating systems with a matrix, and pass the version from build to a later job.
days.deliverable: Workflow file and a run graph
checks: Jobs run in the expected order with six matrix entries
Fail one matrix entry with fail-fast off
Shows the version output from build

days.lab_task: Cache dependencies, pass the built package from the build job to a test job as an artefact, and compare run time with and without the cache.
days.deliverable: Workflow file and a timing comparison
checks: Cached run is faster, with figures
Cache key changes and a new cache is saved
Download the artefact in the test job

subtopics: The github, env and secrets contexts
Secrets in pull requests from forks
days.lab_task: Use a repository secret for an API token and a configuration value for an endpoint, restrict GITHUB_TOKEN to read-only, and prove the secret never appears in logs.
days.deliverable: Workflow file, settings screenshots and a log search
checks: Try to push from the workflow with read-only permissions
Run from a fork pull request

subtopics: Logging in to GitHub Container Registry
days.lab_task: Build, scan and push the app image to GitHub Container Registry with version and commit tags, using build cache, and push only from main.
days.deliverable: Workflow file, scan output and package page
checks: Image appears with version and commit tags
Image is built and scanned but not pushed
objectives: Build and push images from workflows

days.lab_task: Create dev, staging and prod environments with environment secrets, require approval for prod, allow prod deploys only from main, and deploy through all three.
days.deliverable: Environment settings and a deployment history
checks: Try a prod deploy from a feature branch

subtopics: Why long-lived cloud keys are risky
Workload Identity Federation on Google Cloud
Restricting trust by repository and branch
days.lab_task: Configure OIDC so the workflow can deploy to one cloud only from main of this repository, with no stored cloud keys, and show a branch outside the rule is denied.
days.deliverable: Trust configuration, workflow and run evidence
objectives: Restrict trust to repositories and branches

subtopics: Deploying a container to a managed service
tools: Cloud Run, App Service or ECS
days.lab_task: Deploy the container to a managed cloud service in staging then prod, run smoke tests after each deploy, and roll back automatically when the prod smoke test fails.
days.deliverable: Deployment workflow and runs for success and rollback
checks: Smoke tests pass and prod shows it
Second waits because of concurrency rules

days.topic: Reusing Workflows and Writing Composite Actions
subtopics: Inputs, secrets and outputs for reusable workflows
days.lab_task: Move the CI steps into a reusable workflow and the setup steps into a composite action, use both from two repositories, and pin them to a version tag.
days.deliverable: Shared workflow, composite action and two calling workflows
checks: Both use the shared workflow and pass
Change the shared workflow main branch
Repositories pinned to the tag are unaffected
Count lines in a calling workflow

days.topic: Writing Custom JavaScript and Docker Actions
days.lab_task: Write a JavaScript action that comments on pull requests with the size of changed files and fails when a limit is exceeded, with tests and a version tag.
days.deliverable: Action repository, tests and a pull request showing its comment
checks: Action comments and fails the check
Use the action by tag from another repository

days.lab_task: Register an ephemeral self-hosted runner with a custom label, run a job that needs a private network resource on it, and restrict the runner to one repository.
days.deliverable: Runner configuration and run logs
checks: Run a job with the custom label
Runs on the self-hosted runner and reaches the private resource
Run a job from another repository
Check the runner after the job

days.lab_task: Audit a deliberately vulnerable workflow, fix a script injection, pin all actions to SHAs, set per-job permissions, and enable Dependabot updates for actions.
days.deliverable: Audit notes, fixed workflow and Dependabot configuration
checks: Open a pull request with a malicious title
No command runs from the title
Pinned to a full commit SHA
Opens a pull request updating an action

days.topic: Code Quality and Security Scanning in Workflows
days.lab_task: Add CodeQL, dependency review and a container scan uploading SARIF, make them required checks, and block a pull request that adds a vulnerable dependency.
days.deliverable: Workflow files, required check settings and a blocked pull request
checks: Dependency review fails the pull request
Try to merge with a failing required check
objectives: Scan code, dependencies and images in CI

days.lab_task: Create a release workflow that runs on version tags, builds the package, publishes it with trusted publishing, and creates a GitHub release with notes and artefacts.
days.deliverable: Release workflow and a published release
checks: Package is published and the release is created
No registry token needed with trusted publishing

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code in GitHub Actions
days.lab_task: Build workflows that post Terraform plans and cost estimates on pull requests, apply on merge with OIDC and approval, and run a nightly drift check.
days.deliverable: Workflows, a pull request with plan and cost comments, and an apply run
checks: Open a pull request changing infrastructure
objectives: Review plans and costs in pull requests

days.lab_task: Fix six broken workflows prepared by the trainer (syntax, expression, permissions, cache key, missing secret, wrong runner image) and record cause, evidence and fix.
days.deliverable: Troubleshooting log for all six
checks: Fix all six within the time limit
Run one workflow locally with act

subtopics: Stale issue and pull request handling
Using the GitHub CLI in workflows
Writing to issues and pull requests
days.lab_task: Add workflows that label pull requests by changed paths, close stale issues after warning, post a weekly summary issue of merged work, and greet first-time contributors.
days.deliverable: Housekeeping workflows and evidence of each
checks: Open a pull request touching docs
Wait for the weekly schedule or run it manually
Summary issue lists merged pull requests
Open a pull request from a new account
objectives: Use the GitHub CLI in workflows

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End CI/CD with GitHub Actions
subtopics: CI with matrix, caching and scans
OIDC deployment with smoke tests and rollback
days.lab_task: Deliver complete CI/CD for a web application with reusable workflows, caching, scans, image publishing, staged deployments with approval and OIDC, smoke tests and rollback, then demonstrate a failed release.
days.deliverable: Repository with workflows, a release, deployment history and a 10-minute demo
checks: Merge a change during the demo
objectives: Deliver complete CI/CD with GitHub Actions

intermediate.summary: For people who write GitHub Actions workflows. Covers workflow architecture for many repositories, runner fleets, supply chain security, advanced deployments, monorepos, cost and governance.
prerequisites: Writes workflows with matrices, caching, environments and secrets
Comfortable with Docker and one cloud
outcomes: Design shared workflow platforms for many repositories
Secure the software supply chain with attestations and policies
Govern Actions usage and cost across an organisation

subtopics: Versioning and release of shared workflows
days.lab_task: Build a central workflow library for five sample repositories in different languages, require a security workflow through rulesets, and roll out a breaking change in stages.
days.deliverable: Workflow library, ruleset configuration and rollout record
checks: Remove the security workflow from a repository
Roll out a new major version to one repository first
Others stay on the old version
objectives: Design shared workflows for many repositories

days.topic: Runner Fleets with Actions Runner Controller
days.lab_task: Deploy Actions Runner Controller with an autoscaling runner scale set, build a custom runner image with build tools, and run 30 queued jobs.
days.deliverable: Runner configuration, custom image and scaling evidence
checks: Runners scale up and the queue drains within the target time
Run a job needing the custom tools

days.topic: Supply Chain Security: Attestations, Provenance and SLSA
subtopics: Verifying attestations with the GitHub CLI
days.lab_task: Generate build provenance and SBOM attestations for images, verify them before deployment, and refuse to deploy an image without valid provenance.
days.deliverable: Workflow changes, attestations and a refused deployment
checks: Run gh attestation verify on a built image

days.topic: Advanced Workflow Security and Threat Modelling
days.lab_task: Threat model the organisation's workflows, run static analysis to find risky patterns, fix the top findings, and test three attack attempts.
days.deliverable: Threat model, analysis report, fixes and test results
checks: Run the static analyser after fixes
Covers triggers, inputs, permissions and secrets

days.lab_task: Implement a canary deployment to Kubernetes with a metrics check before promotion, and a custom protection rule that blocks prod deploys during a change freeze.
days.deliverable: Workflows, protection rule and runs for success, rollback and freeze

subtopics: Keeping CI under a time budget
days.lab_task: Build CI for a monorepo of eight packages that builds only affected packages through a dynamic matrix, uses a merge queue, and keeps required checks reliable.
days.deliverable: Workflows and runs showing affected builds and the merge queue
checks: Only it and its dependants build
Add two pull requests to the merge queue
Both are tested together and merged
A single aggregate check is required

subtopics: Running fewer jobs on pull requests
days.lab_task: Cut a provided 35-minute workflow to under 10 minutes with caching, test splitting, larger runners where justified and duplicate-run removal, measuring each change.
days.deliverable: Optimised workflow and a timing and cost table
checks: Larger runner cost is justified by time saved

subtopics: Runner cost per minute by OS and size
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of sample usage, find the top cost drivers, cut cost by at least 30% with retention, filters and runner changes, and report cost per team.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis, changes and savings report

days.lab_task: Set organisation policies for allowed actions, default read-only tokens, fork approval and runner groups, then find a policy change in the audit log and produce a compliance report.
days.deliverable: Policy configuration, audit findings and compliance report
checks: Workflow fails because the action is not allowed
Find who changed the allowed actions list
Audit log shows actor and time

days.lab_task: Add integration tests with service containers, Playwright end-to-end tests against a preview environment per pull request, and a k6 performance gate.
days.deliverable: Workflows and a pull request with preview link and test results
checks: Preview environment is created and tests run against it
Make p95 latency exceed the gate

days.topic: GitHub Apps and API Automation in Workflows
subtopics: Using GitHub App tokens in workflows
days.lab_task: Use a GitHub App token to open pull requests in three repositories that update a shared configuration file, and trigger their workflows with repository_dispatch.
days.deliverable: App setup, workflow and the opened pull requests
checks: Pull requests are opened in all three repositories

days.topic: Mobile and Desktop Builds with GitHub Actions
days.lab_task: Build and sign an Android app and a desktop app for Windows and macOS in one workflow, and distribute test builds, keeping signing keys out of logs.
days.deliverable: Workflow, signed builds and distribution evidence
checks: Signed builds for each platform are produced
Recorded with a plan to limit it
objectives: Build mobile and desktop apps in Actions

days.lab_task: Export workflow run data, build dashboards for duration, failure rate and DORA metrics, and alert the team when main stays red for more than 30 minutes.
days.deliverable: Data export, dashboards and alert rule
checks: Deployment frequency and lead time shown

subtopics: Mapping Jenkins, GitLab CI and Azure Pipelines concepts
Converting shared libraries to reusable workflows
Running old and new pipelines in parallel
days.lab_task: Audit and migrate three pipelines from another CI system with the importer, fix untranslated parts, run both in parallel to prove parity, and plan the rest.
days.deliverable: Migrated workflows, parity comparison and migration plan
checks: Run both systems on the same commit
Read the list of manual fixes

days.lab_task: Build a workflow that retrains a small model on new data, evaluates it against the current model, and publishes it only if accuracy improves.
days.deliverable: Workflow, evaluation report and published model
objectives: Run data and ML jobs in Actions

days.lab_task: Make every prod deployment create a change record with commit, tests, scans and approver, enforce separation of duties, and answer three mock auditor questions.
days.deliverable: Workflow changes, sample change records and audit answers
checks: Change record contains all evidence links

days.topic: Inner Source of Actions and Workflows
days.lab_task: Set up an internal catalogue of shared actions with tests, documentation and versioning, accept a contribution from another team, and deprecate an old action.
days.deliverable: Catalogue repository, merged contribution and deprecation record
checks: Each action has docs, tests and an owner

days.topic: Disaster Recovery and Resilience for CI/CD
subtopics: Dependencies of CI: GitHub, registries, clouds
days.lab_task: Make deployments resilient to a registry outage and hosted runner unavailability with mirrors and fallback runners, and run a timed failover test.
days.deliverable: Resilience changes, runbook and test record
checks: Block the main registry during a deploy
Compare recovery time with the target

subtopics: Common incidents: queued jobs, runner failures, rate limits
days.lab_task: Handle four injected incidents (runner fleet down, jobs stuck queued, API rate limits, expired cloud trust) with runbooks you write, and complete one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Four runbooks, incident timelines and one review
checks: Impact, root cause and owned actions

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: CI/CD Platform for an Organisation on GitHub Actions
subtopics: Shared workflow library and required workflows
days.lab_task: Build a CI/CD platform for an organisation with a shared workflow library, required workflows, an autoscaling runner fleet, provenance checks, governance policies and dashboards, then present it.
days.deliverable: Platform repositories, policy configuration, dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Uses the library and required checks automatically
Runner fleet scales and drains within target

advanced.summary: For engineers who run CI/CD on GitHub for large enterprises. Covers enterprise architecture, trusted builds, extreme-scale runners, policy engineering, platform products and CI/CD strategy.
prerequisites: Has built shared workflows and runner fleets for many teams
Comfortable with supply chain security and cloud identity
outcomes: Design enterprise CI/CD architecture on GitHub
Run trusted, verifiable builds at scale
Engineer policy, governance and cost for thousands of repositories
Lead CI/CD strategy with measured outcomes

subtopics: Runner strategy: hosted, larger and self-hosted
days.lab_task: Design CI/CD architecture for an enterprise with 40 organisations and 8,000 repositories, and write decision records for workflow library, runner and identity strategy.
days.deliverable: Architecture document and three decision records
checks: Explains which workloads use which runner type and why
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Participant explains OIDC trust at scale

days.topic: Trusted Builds at Scale: SLSA Level 3
days.lab_task: Move builds for three services to isolated reusable build workflows producing SLSA level 3 provenance, verify it at Kubernetes admission, and report coverage.
days.deliverable: Build workflows, verification policy and coverage report
checks: Deploy an image without valid provenance
Shows services with and without level 3 builds

days.lab_task: Load test a runner platform with 2,000 queued jobs, reduce job start time with warm pools and image caching, and write a capacity plan.
days.deliverable: Load test results, tuning changes and capacity plan
checks: Interrupt spot nodes during the test
objectives: Run runner platforms at extreme scale

subtopics: Static analysis of workflows at scale
days.lab_task: Scan every workflow in a sample organisation for risky patterns, roll out blocking rules in audit mode then enforce mode, and report results by team.
days.deliverable: Scanner configuration, rollout record and report
checks: Pull requests adding risky patterns are blocked

days.topic: Secrets and Identity Architecture for CI/CD
subtopics: OIDC to every cloud and vault
days.lab_task: Replace all long-lived secrets in sample repositories with OIDC to clouds and Vault, tighten trust conditions to environment and workflow, and audit identity use.
days.deliverable: Identity configuration, secret inventory before and after and audit report
checks: Use the trust from a different workflow file

days.topic: Platform Engineering: CI/CD as an Internal Product
days.lab_task: Build a golden path that creates a repository with workflows, environments, rulesets and a deployment target in one request, and measure time to first deploy.
days.deliverable: Template, created repository and experience metrics
checks: Create a service from the template
First deploy succeeds within the target time
Rulesets and required workflows are applied
Time to first deploy and satisfaction measured

days.lab_task: Orchestrate a release of five dependent services in order with health checks, roll all back when one fails, and show the release on a dashboard.
days.deliverable: Orchestration workflow and release records for success and rollback

subtopics: SLOs for CI: queue time, success rate, duration
days.lab_task: Define CI SLOs, run chaos tests on registries, runners and cloud APIs, add mitigations, and report SLO impact.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, chaos results, mitigations and SLO report

subtopics: Cost drivers across thousands of repositories
Unit cost per build and deploy
days.lab_task: Build an enterprise cost model from usage exports, cut cost by at least 35% while meeting CI SLOs, and publish chargeback by organisation.
days.deliverable: Cost model, changes, SLO evidence and chargeback report

days.lab_task: Implement validated release workflows for a regulated product with automated evidence, change records and segregation of duties, and run a mock audit of a quarter.
days.deliverable: Workflows, evidence store and mock audit results
checks: Answer an auditor request for a release
Try to bypass the validated workflow
Author cannot approve their own release

days.lab_task: Inventory 400 sample pipelines from other CI systems, classify them, migrate a pilot wave automatically, prove parity, and report blockers.
days.deliverable: Inventory, classification, pilot results and blocker report
checks: Each pipeline has a class and reason
Each has an owner and plan

days.topic: Building GitHub Apps for CI/CD Platforms
subtopics: When an app beats a workflow
days.lab_task: Build a GitHub App that adds a check run enforcing deployment policies on pull requests, with idempotent webhook handling and tests, deployed reliably.
days.deliverable: App code, tests and a pull request showing the check run
checks: Open a pull request breaking a policy
Check run fails with an explanation
objectives: Build platform features as GitHub Apps

subtopics: Risks: data exposure and wrong suggestions
days.lab_task: Add an AI step that summarises failed runs with likely causes, evaluate it against 50 labelled failures, and set rules for redaction and human confirmation.
days.deliverable: Workflow step, evaluation results and rules
checks: Check data sent to the model

days.topic: Advanced Troubleshooting of the Actions Platform
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix seven hard platform failures injected by the trainer, including scaling delays, rate limit storms and broken OIDC trust across many repositories.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis log with symptom, evidence, root cause and fix for each
checks: Job start time returns to normal
objectives: Use metrics and logs at scale

subtopics: GitHub Actions compared with GitLab CI, Jenkins and Azure Pipelines
days.lab_task: Implement the same standard pipeline in GitHub Actions and one other system, compare speed, security, cost and effort, and write a platform decision record.
days.deliverable: Both implementations, comparison and decision record
checks: Run both on the same commit
Measured speed and estimated cost for both

days.lab_task: Respond to a simulated compromised third-party action: find every repository using it, contain, revoke affected credentials, review run logs for misuse and report.
days.deliverable: Incident timeline, affected repository list, revocation record and report
checks: Matches a scan of all workflows
objectives: Respond to CI supply chain incidents

subtopics: Measuring flow from commit to production
days.lab_task: Build delivery metrics for 20 sample teams from Actions and repository data, identify the three biggest bottlenecks, and propose measurable improvements.
days.deliverable: Metrics dashboard, bottleneck analysis and improvement plan
checks: Recompute lead time for one team by hand
Each improvement has a target metric

subtopics: Speed, security, cost and reliability criteria
days.lab_task: Review another team's CI/CD platform design, write two decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations with evidence.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Defended with cost and risk evidence

days.topic: CI/CD Strategy and Roadmap on GitHub
days.lab_task: Assess a provided enterprise's CI/CD maturity on GitHub, propose a three-year roadmap, and present it to a mock leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, roadmap and presentation
checks: Each area has evidence and a level
Items have outcomes, owners and metrics
Budget and risk questions answered with evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise CI/CD Platform on GitHub
days.lab_task: Design and prototype an enterprise CI/CD platform on GitHub covering architecture, runners, trusted builds, policy, identity, reliability, cost and developer experience, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working prototype, security and reliability test evidence, cost model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Untrusted builds and risky workflows are blocked
CI SLOs met during dependency failures
Costs are broken down and justified
objectives: Design an enterprise CI/CD platform on GitHub
Prove security, reliability and cost with evidence
Defend the design to a review board
